name: dj-mix
description: Spicetify extension that orders a Spotify playlist like a DJ set: harmonic mixing on the Camelot wheel, an energy arc and smooth tempo steps.

scripts.purge: for f in dj-mix.js manifest.json README.md assets/cover.png; do curl -s https://purge.jsdelivr.net/gh/smixs/dj-mix@main/$f >/dev/null; done; echo purged
